The '''Duros Run''', also known as the '''Duros Space Run''', was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] located in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It began at [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] and passed through the [[Forvand system/Legends|Forvand system]].<ref name="SoF" />
